name: flight-booking
description: Flight booking challenge — modular monolith with real-time seat inventory

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @flight/shared && npm run build --workspace @flight/backend && npm run build --workspace @flight/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @flight/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @flight/shared && npm run test:unit --workspace @flight/backend
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @flight/shared && npm run test:integration --workspace @flight/backend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
